newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian GDP rose provisional 0.5 pct in Q3 96.
newsitem.headline: Italian GDP rose provisional 0.5 pct in Q3 96.

text.p: Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) rose by a provisional 0.5 percent, year on year, in the third quarter of 1996, National Statistics Institute Istat said. ITALIAN GDP Q3 1996 Q2 1996 Q3 1995
Note: Istat said there were three more working days in the third quarter than in the second quarter 1996.
-- Istat said there was one more working day in the third quarter 1996 than in the third quarter 1995.
-- Final GDP data for the third quarter will be released on January 7, 1997.
